detail.longDescription: My SvelteKit project runs svelte-check in GitLab CI: check: image: node:24-alpine script: - npm ci - npx svelte-kit sync - npx svelte-check When the job fails, the type errors are only in the job log, so reviewers have to open the log to see them. ESLint's errors show up in the merge request's Code Quality widget, but svelte-check has no output format for GitLab. How can I get svelte-check's errors into the merge request, ideally showing only the errors the merge request adds?
